column1: # The PGS Catalog scores step 25 and the PRS process run, one per line.
# trait_reported is the trait exactly as https://www.pgscatalog.org/rest/score/<pgs_id>
# reports it; scripts/ci/check-pgs-labels.sh compares the two, so an id
# cannot be printed under the wrong disease. setup.sh downloads each score's
# applies_to names the sex a score was built for (female or male; empty for
# both). A sample declared as the other sex keeps the score's raw sum in the
# summary, marked "not applicable to the declared sex", with no percentile.
# ppm_id, ancestry and effect name the PGS Catalog evaluations (PPM ids) whose
# effect the reports print: one entry per evaluated ancestry, separated by
# ";" and in the same order in the three columns. ancestry is the 1000
# Genomes group pgsc_calc compares the sample with (AFR, AMR, EAS, EUR or SAS);
# effect is the odds ratio (OR) or hazard ratio (HR) the catalog records for
# that evaluation, in the unit the evaluation used. A report prints it only
# when pgsc_calc placed the sample in that group. Empty for a score with no
# OR or HR evaluation in one of those groups (the quantitative traits, and
# scores evaluated only in mixed or unreported ancestries).
